summary.en: A pull quote pasted across the sheet: a band of warm paper, the page's words in large grotesk, each phrase rising into its line box.
summary.zh: 横贴在长卷上的引语：一条暖白纸，页面原话用大号无衬线字，每个短语升进自己的行框。

fits: Quoting a line of a captured page in readable type.
notFor: Words the page does not say; more than two lines.

intent.en: Make a line of the page readable without retyping the page: paste the words over it.
intent.zh: 不重排页面也能让一句话读得清：把这句话贴在上面。

content.en: 1–2 lines of phrases (≤ 20 chars each), the page's own words.
content.zh: 1–2 行短语（每段 ≤ 6 字），页面原话。

fits.zh: 把截图页面上的一句话用可读的字号引出来。

notFor.zh: 页面没说的话；超过两行。

en: Never add a claim: cut words only.
zh: 只删不加：不许添新主张。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
